Adalék EUROL Petrol Octane Improver 250 ml:
	

	
	
	
	Eurol Petrol Octane Improver is designed to increase the octane number (RON) of petrol. Using the recommended dosage, Eurol Petrol Octane Improver increases the octane number by 4 to 6 points.
